listing.name: F.E.A.R. Files (Xbox 360) — F.E.A.R. 360 Recompiled (Juansolo457)
listing.summary: Upstream says Files boots/plays and reports 4K/80FPS with its optional own-PC texture pack and inherited right-stick fix. Files-specific smoke/effects, optimization and both expansion campaigns/full playthrough remain open. Do not inherit every base-game fix or completion claim. Native Linux build is untested; Steam Deck uses experimental Proton; Android ARM64 is scoped/not started. No Portcove runtime/gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source-only v0.1.0 route: prepare the patched SDK with tools/setup-sdk.ps1, then locally compile this title using tools/build-nx.ps1 -Project port-files. tools/launch.ps1 -Collection can select it after independent preparation.
